result.instructions: Tools for Nutshell, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads in my pipeline are worth more than 10,000 and still open?"; "Show the contact details and recent notes for Jane Smith at Acme."; "Create a follow-up task for the owner of lead 1003 due next Monday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nutshell data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nutshell_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nutshell_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nutshell_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nutshell_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nutshell_create_task

tools.description: Create a task, optionally linked to an entity and assigned to a user. POST /rest/tasks.

assignee.description: API ID of the user to assign, for example 1-users.

tools.name: nutshell_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: Change one lead with a JSON Patch list. Each operation is {"op": "replace"|"add"|"remove", "path": "/leads/0/<field>", "value": ...}. PATCH /rest/leads/{id}.

operations.description: JSON Patch operations. Paths start with /leads/0/, for example /leads/0/description.
